light_description: High-gain fuzz combined with uncontrolled oscillation; current Japanese dealer documentation identifies it as a handmade MASF Pedals product and preserves exterior imagery.
Octave-down fuzz derived for harsh-noise use, with switchable octave intervals; documented as a MASF Pedals fuzz/noise effect with exterior product imagery.
High-gain fuzz designed around psychedelic, heavy and noisy guitar textures; first-party MASF Store documentation provides an exterior image set.
High-output upper-octave fuzz using Volume/Gain interaction as a major part of its sound; Japanese dealer documentation preserves the product identity and exterior imagery.

Deep drive pedal based around early Black Sabbath-associated tones with three modes spanning heavier and more extreme textures; official/first-party-adjacent dealer documentation provides product photography.
Wave-shaper drive pedal with selectable one-to-three shaping stages capable of booster, overdrive, distortion and fuzz textures; dealer documentation provides product identity and images.
Five-control extreme-sound pedal whose own documentation says it does not primarily produce heavy distortion and is intended to interact with other effects; retained outside central dirt.
Bass-oriented fuzz with blend, filter and gain controls; historical Japanese dealer documentation identifies it specifically as a bass fuzz.
Historical MASF pedal documented in the Japanese dealer catalog and 2016 LEP documentation; retained as a dirt-family record pending a stronger first-party product description.
Current M.A.S.F. pedal combining distortion with a two-octave-down octavizer, documented by the builder's current store with five exterior product images.
Tremolo effect in the MASF catalog; excluded from central dirt because its primary function is modulation.
Glitch/hold effect with momentary operation and variable repetition/hold behavior; excluded from central dirt because it is primarily a time-based experimental effect.
Experimental noise effect based around percussive/impact sound; excluded from central dirt.
Oscillator product in the wider MASF family; excluded from central dirt.
Oscillator/noise-oriented MASF product; excluded from central dirt.
